sources.title: Open-Meteo daily precipitation (forecast past_days and ERA5 archive)

provenance.note: Open-Meteo daily precipitation summed over 2026-08-20 to 2026-09-19 for 154 Gram Panchayats, queried at the bounding-box centre of each DataMeet polygon (from the directory), collapsed to 41 reanalysis grid cells: Panchayats whose centroids share a cell share its series, which the per-record grid coordinates and offset state. The normal is a 11-year mean of the same calendar window from the ERA5 archive for the same grid point.

conventions.measurement: modelled reanalysis interpolated to a grid point inside the Panchayat, not a rain gauge; gridOffsetKm is the distance from the queried centroid to the returned grid cell
conventions.window: 30 days ending on the acquisition date, matching the profile's current-rainfall limit
